name: Canonical C-1 Method A linear fixture v1

independent_vectors.meaning: Independent Decimal evaluation of official formulas, not officially tabulated pixel vectors

input.components: R/G/B absolute cd/m2, row-major IEEE-754 f64 little endian

diagnostics_each_run.standard_counter_meaning: Table 3 negative Cr correction terms discarded by max; NOT output clipping
